text: dsh-auto-chat-titles（DSH 网页插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 会话自动生成贴合语义的标题。它注册会话标题提供器，在首条合适的人类消息后调用 DSH 的标题 LLM 服务，并保留核心会话标题服务。用户可以让标题模型沿用当前对话路由或固定选择模型，在插件设置中调整标题长度、上下文窗口和生成限制，也能从会话标题栏点击重新生成，或输入 /regenerate-title 命令。手动重生成会取最近的人类消息作为上下文，适合希望自动整理会话列表、并按需修正标题的 DSH 网页用户。需要可用的 DSH 模型路由；插件本身没有额外密钥配置。

dsh-auto-chat-titles creates semantic DSH conversation titles from the first eligible human message. Choose the conversation route or a fixed model and tune limits. Regenerate from the header or /regenerate-title using recent messages. Requires a DSH model route.
想让 DSH 根据聊天内容自动起一个简短标题。
会话列表里的标题太随意了，能不能让模型概括主题？
我想给生成会话标题单独指定一个便宜的模型。
让聊天标题参考最近几条消息，而不是只看开头。
能在当前会话里手动重新生成标题吗？
Give each conversation a concise title that reflects what we discussed.
Can a chat title be updated after the conversation has moved on?
dsh-auto-chat-titles 的功能「自动生成语义标题」：会话出现首条合适的人类消息后，插件调用 DSH 标题 LLM 服务生成标题，并继承或指定标题模型路由。
dsh-auto-chat-titles 的功能「手动重生成」：从会话标题栏点击按钮，或在输入框执行 /regenerate-title，以当前会话重新生成标题；手动模式最多使用设置指定的近期人类消息。
dsh-auto-chat-titles 的功能「标题生成设置」：在设置插件页面选择跟随会话模型或固定模型，并调整词数、CJK 字符数、输入字节数、输出 token、超时和重生成上下文。
希望标题能控制在适合会话列表展示的长度。

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · dsh-auto-chat-titles：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Semantic, configurable chat titles for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The plugin keeps DSH's durable session-title service and replaces only its built-in provider policy. It adds:

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1-rc.2 or newer compatible 0.1.x prerelease
- Node.js 22+
- Web profile with the standard session-title, settings, commands, and client runtime bundles

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · Install：Directly from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:leonardoxr/dsh-auto-chat-titles
```

From a checkout while developing:

```sh
npm install
npm run check
dsh plugin --profile web add "C:/absolute/path/to/dsh-auto-chat-titles"
```

Host output is hot-reloaded via the active watcher. Browser client changes require rebuilding the client artifacts and refreshing the existing DSH Web page.

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · How it composes：The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` disables only the base `session-title-llm` row and inserts this plugin. It intentionally leaves the core `session-title` service enabled. DSH supports one asynchronous title provider at a time, so enabling both provider rows is an error.

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · How it composes：Automatic generation uses the first eligible human message. Clicking **Regenerate title** calls the same durable service explicitly and uses up to the configured number of recent human messages. Manual rename continues to pin the title; explicit regeneration deliberately unpins and replaces it.

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · Settings：Open **Settings → Plugins → Automatic chat titles**.

- **Title model** — inherit the exact conversation route or choose any model advertised by the host catalog.
- **Title length** — target words for non-CJK languages.
- **Regeneration context** — number of recent human messages included in manual regeneration.
- **Advanced generation limits** — CJK length, framed input bytes, output tokens, and timeout.
dsh-auto-chat-titles README · Settings：The settings are stored in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` under `auto-chat-titles` when the standard file settings provider is mounted.

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · Commands：The UI action invokes `/regenerate-title`. It can also be entered directly in the composer. The button confirms command admission; the conversation activity reports the eventual generation result. Command lifecycle events remain in the session audit log, and the generated title is persisted as DSH's standard `session/title` event.

dsh-auto-chat-titles README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

The host half compiles to `lib/`. The browser half compiles to the DSH lazy-CJS module in `client/client.js`.
